changes.comment: Fix `loadTheme` throwing when `document.body` is not available yet, when there is no `document`, or when the theme object has no prototype or has a slot named `hasOwnProperty`. Read the CSP nonce from `window.CSPSettings` each time a style element is inserted instead of once at module load. Make `splitStyles` independent of an earlier call that threw. Stop measuring the duration of `loadStyles` and `flush`.
